reason: Prioritize the approved Strassen path: it is the only proposal with a stated reduction in arithmetic, though copying, recombination, and FP32 error make its net benefit uncertain. The Strassen workspace variants follow; they share the same unmeasured algorithm, so their order reflects bounded reuse and allocation simplicity, not measured gains. A-panel packing and transpose fusion could reduce scratch traffic but add substantial data movement. Tile scheduling and ownership changes have lower expected impact; earlier FMOPA reordering did not promote. Fallback-only proposals do not affect the fixed n=512 timing path. The paired-load proposal has unverified instruction legality and should be last. No proposal has measured performance evidence.
